messages:
Ethan: Bringing marigold-v1 (fp16 -> q4) up on staging; quick smoke shows weird glue between Han characters and following Arabic tokens.
Mei: example?
Ethan: short repro below. baseline (fp16) vs q4 (staging canary):
```
INPUT: "今天は \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 arrived."
FP16: "今天は \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 arrived."
Q4: "今天は\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 arrived."  <-- missing separator between Han and Arabic
```
Hana: tokenization differences? detok rules?
Ethan: token-id diff for this sample shows identical ids. The detok pipeline seems to fall back to "simple-join" in q4. Also ran a quick eval on our mixed-orient 1k set: zh->ar BLEU -0.8, separator-failures +12%.
Ravi: Check logs for profile load. We had similar path resolution flakiness with other quant builds.
Ethan: logs excerpt: 
```
2026-03-24T09:12:01Z marigold-init: tokenizer v2 loaded
2026-03-24T09:12:01Z quant-bootstrap: q4 kernels init
2026-03-24T09:12:01Z profile-loader: open('/opt/model/profiles/locale.json') -> OK
2026-03-24T09:12:01Z detok: loading locale rules -> success
2026-03-24T09:12:01Z detok: postprocess step replaced by fallback simple-join  <-- odd
```
Mei: If locale rules loaded OK, fallback implies runtime branch forced by a flag or state. Any env differences between fp16 and q4 containers?
Ravi: q4 runtime sets FLAG_DETOK_SAFE=true to enable a fast code path that avoids heavy Unicode checks. Maybe that path has a bug for mixed-script adjacency rules.
Hana: Could be a guard that bails to simple-join when a fast-detok invariants check fails. We should add a startup smoke that validates a handful of mixed-script pairs before accepting the canary.
Ethan: Agreed. Proposed actions: 1) disable FLAG_DETOK_SAFE in q4 canary, 2) add detok-smoke to model bring-up smoke (1000 samples, fail if separator-rate drop >5% vs fp16), 3) add unit test covering Han->Arabic adjacency in fast-path.
Mei: I'll open PR for the fast-path fix + unit test. @Ravi please queue a ci detok smoke for marigold-q4.
Ravi: infra-bot: queue job ci/marigold-detok-smoke/q4-2026-03-24 --samples=1000
infra-bot: Job queued: ci/marigold-detok-smoke/q4-2026-03-24 #2048. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2048 :white_check_mark:
Ethan: Filing ML ticket ML-3625 with failing sample ids and diffs so we have reproducible corpus. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-3625
Hana: Good. Let's gate the wider rollout until CI smoke and the unit test land. I'll hold the canary expansion.
Mei: PR incoming, requesting expedited review.
Ethan: Will post the ci run outcome here when available. Thanks everyone.
